name: Computer Modelling Group Ltd.
summary: Computer Modelling Group Ltd., a software and consulting technology company, engages in the development and licensing of reservoir simulation and seismic interpretation software and related services. The company offers CMOST, an optimization and analysis tool that offers solution for reservoir by combining statistical analysis, machine learning, and impartial data interpretation; IMEX, a black oil reservoir simulator that is used to model primary, secondary, and tertiary oil recovery processes in conventional and unconventional reservoirs; and GEM, an equation of state reservoir simulator software for compositional, chemical, and unconventional reservoir modelling.
